checks.title: System identification and OS version
checks.expected: Hostname, OS, version, architecture, domain and serial recorded
checks.description: Records the device identity so the system inventory (hardware/firmware/software) is maintained from live data.
checks.remediation: Keep the asset record current; retire devices that no longer report.

checks.title: Installed software inventory
checks.description: Lists installed applications (name, version, publisher) so software baselines and user-installed software can be reviewed.
checks.remediation: Compare against the approved software list; remove unapproved software.

checks.title: Local user accounts
checks.expected: Local accounts with enabled/admin flags recorded
checks.description: Lists local accounts so authorized users can be reconciled against HR/authorization records.
checks.remediation: Disable or remove accounts that are not authorized.

checks.title: Listening network ports and services
checks.description: Lists listening ports and owning processes so nonessential ports/services can be identified and disabled.
checks.remediation: Disable services that are not on the essential-services list.

checks.title: Local administrator accounts are limited
checks.expected: At most {max_admins} enabled local administrator accounts
checks.description: Counts enabled members of the local Administrators/sudo/admin group.
checks.remediation: Remove day-to-day users from the local admin group; use a separate admin account for administrative work.

checks.title: Guest account is disabled
checks.description: Checks the built-in Guest account (Windows) or guest login (macOS).
checks.remediation: Disable the Guest account.

checks.title: Blank passwords are not permitted
checks.expected: No enabled account may have an empty password
checks.description: Windows: LimitBlankPasswordUse=1. Linux: no enabled account with an empty password field (needs root). macOS: pwpolicy minimum length > 0.
checks.remediation: Set a password on every enabled account; enforce the policy.

checks.title: Inactive accounts are disabled
checks.expected: No enabled local account without a logon in {inactive_days} days
checks.description: Finds enabled local accounts whose last logon is older than the threshold (or that never logged on but are older than the threshold).
checks.remediation: Disable accounts that have not been used within the defined period.

checks.title: Automatic logon is disabled
checks.description: Checks HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon.
checks.remediation: Disable AutoAdminLogon and remove DefaultPassword.

checks.title: User Account Control is enabled
checks.description: UAC forces privilege elevation prompts so non-privileged sessions cannot silently run privileged functions.
checks.remediation: Enable UAC via policy; set 'Prompt for consent on the secure desktop'.

checks.title: Minimum password length
checks.description: Windows: net accounts / secedit MinimumPasswordLength. Linux: pwquality minlen or login.defs PASS_MIN_LEN. macOS: pwpolicy.
checks.remediation: Set the minimum length in policy (Group Policy, pwquality.conf, or pwpolicy).

checks.title: Password complexity is enforced
checks.description: Windows: PasswordComplexity=1. Linux: pwquality minclass>=3 or dcredit/ucredit/lcredit/ocredit. macOS: pwpolicy requiresAlpha/requiresNumeric.
checks.remediation: Enable complexity in policy.

checks.title: Password reuse is prohibited
checks.description: Windows: PasswordHistorySize. Linux: pam_pwhistory remember=. macOS: pwpolicy usingHistory.
checks.remediation: Configure password history.

checks.title: Account lockout after failed logons
checks.description: Windows: LockoutBadCount. Linux: pam_faillock deny=. macOS: pwpolicy maxFailedLoginAttempts.
checks.remediation: Configure lockout threshold and duration.

checks.title: Screen lock after inactivity with password
checks.expected: Lock within {max_seconds} seconds of inactivity, password required, screen contents hidden
checks.description: Windows: ScreenSaveActive/ScreenSaverIsSecure/ScreenSaveTimeOut or InactivityTimeoutSecs. Linux: GNOME idle-delay + lock-enabled. macOS: askForPassword + idleTime.
checks.remediation: Enforce a 15-minute (or shorter) lock with password via policy or MDM.

checks.title: Logon notice/banner is displayed
checks.description: Windows: LegalNoticeCaption/LegalNoticeText. Linux: /etc/issue, /etc/issue.net and sshd Banner. macOS: PolicyBanner.
checks.remediation: Configure the CUI/monitoring notice banner.

checks.title: Idle sessions are terminated
checks.expected: Idle session termination configured (RDP MaxIdleTime / shell TMOUT / sshd ClientAlive)
checks.description: Windows: Terminal Services MaxIdleTime and MaxDisconnectionTime. Linux/macOS: TMOUT in profile.d and sshd ClientAliveInterval/CountMax.
checks.remediation: Configure automatic session termination after a defined idle period.

checks.title: Host firewall is enabled
checks.description: Windows: all three profiles On. Linux: ufw/firewalld/nftables active with a default-deny input policy. macOS: application firewall enabled.
checks.remediation: Enable the host firewall on all profiles.

checks.title: Inbound traffic is denied by default
checks.expected: Default inbound action = Block on every profile
checks.description: Windows: DefaultInboundAction Block. Linux: INPUT policy DROP/REJECT or firewalld default zone drop/block/public. macOS: block all incoming or stealth mode.
checks.remediation: Set default inbound action to Block and allow only required services by exception.

checks.title: Remote access is disabled or hardened
checks.expected: Remote access disabled, or RDP requires NLA and SSH allows only key-based, non-root logins
checks.description: Windows: fDenyTSConnections=1, or UserAuthentication=1 (NLA) and SecurityLayer=2. Linux/macOS: sshd not running, or PermitRootLogin no and PasswordAuthentication no.
checks.remediation: Disable remote access where not needed; otherwise require NLA/keys, MFA and TLS.

checks.title: Legacy/insecure protocols are disabled
checks.expected: SMBv1, Telnet, FTP, rsh/rlogin, TFTP not enabled/installed
checks.description: Windows: SMB1 feature disabled, TelnetClient/TFTP features off. Linux/macOS: telnet/ftp/rsh servers absent, no listening on 21/23/69/512-514.
checks.remediation: Remove or disable legacy services and features.

checks.title: System clock synchronizes with an authoritative time source
checks.expected: NTP/W32Time configured with a source and last sync within {max_hours} hours
checks.description: Windows: w32tm /query /status. Linux: timedatectl / chronyc / ntpq. macOS: systemsetup -getusingnetworktime.
checks.remediation: Configure NTP against the domain controller or an authoritative source.

checks.title: Audit logging is enabled
checks.expected: Security auditing active for logon, account management and policy change events
checks.description: Windows: EventLog service running and auditpol shows Logon/Logoff, Account Management, Policy Change with Success+Failure. Linux: auditd or journald active. macOS: unified logging / auditd.
checks.remediation: Enable audit policy (Advanced Audit Policy Configuration) or auditd.

checks.title: Audit logs are retained
checks.expected: Security log max size >= {min_mb} MB and not set to overwrite immediately; or journald persistent storage / auditd rotation configured
checks.description: Windows: Security log MaxSize and Retention. Linux: journald Storage=persistent, auditd max_log_file_action.
checks.remediation: Increase log size, forward logs to a central collector/SIEM, define retention.

checks.title: Privileged actions are audited
checks.expected: Auditing of privilege use / process creation / sudo enabled
checks.description: Windows: Audit Sensitive Privilege Use and Process Creation with command line logging. Linux: sudo logging, auditd rules for execve by root. macOS: sudo logs to unified log.
checks.remediation: Enable auditing of privileged functions.

checks.title: PowerShell script block logging is enabled
checks.description: Script block logging captures PowerShell activity used in most modern attacks.
checks.remediation: Enable via Group Policy: Turn on PowerShell Script Block Logging.

checks.title: Anti-malware is installed and real-time protection is on
checks.expected: Anti-malware product present with real-time protection enabled
checks.description: Windows: Get-MpComputerStatus (Defender) or SecurityCenter2 AntiVirusProduct. Linux: clamd/other EDR present. macOS: XProtect plus EDR/AV.
checks.remediation: Deploy and enable anti-malware with real-time scanning.

checks.title: Anti-malware signatures are current
checks.description: Checks the signature/definition age reported by the product.
checks.remediation: Fix update connectivity; enable automatic definition updates.

checks.title: Periodic anti-malware scans run
checks.description: Checks the last quick/full scan timestamp.
checks.remediation: Schedule a weekly scan.

checks.title: Operating system is being patched
checks.expected: Most recent OS update installed within {max_days} days
checks.description: Windows: last installed hotfix / WU history. Linux: package manager log. macOS: softwareupdate history.
checks.remediation: Install pending updates; enable automatic updates or a patch schedule.

checks.title: No outstanding security updates
checks.description: Windows: WU search via COM (may be slow) or PSWindowsUpdate if present. Linux: apt/dnf security update count. macOS: softwareupdate -l.
checks.remediation: Install outstanding updates.

checks.title: Automatic updates are enabled
checks.description: Windows: AUOptions 3/4 or WSUS/Intune managed. Linux: unattended-upgrades / dnf-automatic. macOS: AutomaticallyInstallMacOSUpdates.
checks.remediation: Enable automatic updates or enroll in a managed patch process.

checks.title: Operating system version is supported by the vendor
checks.expected: OS release still receives security updates
checks.description: Flags end-of-life releases (e.g. Windows 10 after Oct 2025, EOL Linux releases, macOS older than N-2).
checks.remediation: Upgrade or isolate end-of-life systems.

checks.title: Full-disk encryption is enabled
checks.description: Windows: Get-BitLockerVolume or manage-bde. Linux: LUKS on root/home. macOS: fdesetup status.
checks.remediation: Enable full-disk encryption and escrow recovery keys.

checks.title: FIPS-validated cryptography mode
checks.description: Windows: FipsAlgorithmPolicy Enabled=1. Linux: /proc/sys/crypto/fips_enabled=1.
checks.remediation: Enable FIPS mode where the platform supports it; document FIPS 140 validated modules otherwise.

checks.title: Legacy SSL/TLS protocols disabled
checks.expected: SSL 2.0/3.0 and TLS 1.0/1.1 disabled (server and client)
checks.description: Checks SCHANNEL protocol registry keys.
checks.remediation: Disable legacy protocols via policy.

checks.title: SMB signing is required
checks.description: SMB signing protects session authenticity between Windows hosts.
checks.remediation: Require SMB signing via Group Policy.

checks.title: USB mass storage is controlled
checks.expected: USB storage disabled or restricted by policy
checks.description: Windows: USBSTOR Start=4 or RemovableStorageDevices Deny_All. Linux: usb-storage blacklisted. macOS: MDM media restriction profile.
checks.remediation: Block USB storage by policy or allow-list approved encrypted drives.

checks.title: AutoRun/AutoPlay is disabled
checks.description: Prevents automatic execution from removable media.
checks.remediation: Disable AutoPlay via Group Policy.

checks.title: Gatekeeper is enabled
checks.description: Gatekeeper blocks unsigned/unnotarized software.
checks.remediation: Enable Gatekeeper.

checks.title: System Integrity Protection is enabled
checks.description: SIP protects system files and processes.
checks.remediation: Enable SIP from Recovery.

checks.title: Secure Boot / UEFI is enabled
checks.description: Windows: Confirm-SecureBootUEFI. Linux: mokutil --sb-state or efivars.
checks.remediation: Enable Secure Boot in firmware.
